commands.name: mode
commands.description: Switch auto/manual participation at the next round barrier.

commands.name: vote
commands.description: Request a forced weighted vote at the next round barrier.

commands.name: consensus
commands.description: Request a coordinator consensus attempt at the next round barrier.

commands.name: cast
commands.description: Add or remove a roster member at the next round barrier.

commands.name: fork
commands.description: Fork this session through the existing session fork verb.

commands.name: promote
commands.description: Promote this chat through the existing promotion verb.

commands.name: send
commands.description: Route an artifact to a section through route_push.

commands.name: summarize
commands.description: Ask Documentation to summarize the conversation.

commands.name: decision
commands.template: @Planning what decision are we converging on here?
commands.description: Ask Planning to name the emerging decision.

commands.name: compare
commands.description: Compare one prompt across selected enabled models without changing the room.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show this session's persisted run status.

commands.name: cost
commands.description: Show this session's honest metered/unmetered cost rollup.

commands.name: help
commands.description: Show the effective layered command registry grouped by kind.

commands.name: model-effort
commands.description: Return an advisory card only; do not perform the task. Use the seeded model-effort rubric to recommend one model and one supported effort, with a one-line rationale. Label a known-price estimate with ≈; otherwise say unmetered. End with 'Run with this' as an explicit next action that would use the original input unchanged.

commands.name: gen-prompt
commands.description: Return an editable structured-prompt card only; do not run or answer the rough input. Organize it into Goal, Context, Constraints, Output format, and Acceptance criteria. End with explicit Insert and Cancel actions; neither action is automatic and the command itself sends nothing.

commands.name: snippet
commands.template: Choose a saved snippet in the composer; review the rendered text before sending.
commands.description: Insert a named saved snippet into the composer; never auto-send it.
